hero-bullet: No Korean public holiday in November — skip the queue in 15–20 min
peak-body: Korea's college entrance exam on 19 November halts every takeoff and landing in the country from 13:10 to 13:35, and Thai Airways returns to Da Nang with two daily Bangkok flights from 1 December. Two or three landings in one hour fill the Terminal 2 immigration hall — 60 to 90 minutes.
faq-night: November averages 20 rainy days in Da Nang, and delays push arrivals later. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.
